title: Make operational modes strict orchestrators: main agent thinks/plans only; all reads/execution delegated to subagents across NORMAL/PLAN/INVESTIGATE/SPEC/TEAM/CHAIN/PIPELINE
description: Refactor every operational-mode system prompt so the main frontier model is restricted to planning and synthesis only. All file reads, code execution, builds, tests, and grep/find operations delegate to subagents. Drops Bash/Read carve-outs, removes contradictory 'work directly' language, and centralizes the policy in one shared helper. Saves frontier tokens by making delegation the default, not the exception.
